comparison.objective: Fit a compression-only diagonal brace so a sagging gate remains square after release.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace orientation, end alignment, compression fitting, and structural load transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Gate supports itself after release, scored by latch-side drop; the numeric allowable drop is not present in this record.
comparison.reason: Tests passive structural bracing and retained geometry, not adjustable damping and repeated impact performance.
